// Vendored snapshot. Do not edit — re-export instead.

{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.12


|gr1= Variables

|descr= Compares two values by reference, returns [[true]] if not equal.

|s1= val1 [[isNotEqualRef]] val2

|p1= val1: [[Anything]]

|p2= val2: [[Anything]]

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] if not the same reference

|x1= <sqf>
_arr1 = [1,[2,[3]]];
_arr2 = _arr1;
_arr1 isEqualTo _arr2;		// true
_arr1 isNotEqualRef _arr2;	// false

_arr2 = +_arr1;				// array copy
_arr1 isEqualTo _arr2;		// true
_arr1 isNotEqualRef _arr2;	// true
</sqf>

|seealso= [[isEqualRef]] [[isNotEqualTo]] [[Operators]]
}}
